comment: The output range in the default output mode runs from 0V to just under 10V: the last step is one step short of 10V because the step number is divided by the whole count (Ministep.cpp:176-178). In the 1V per step mode the top voltage is one less than the count of steps. The MAX box is a plain text widget rather than a parameter, so no click on it reaches this help; it is covered by a note. SCL is read per channel but its own channel count is not part of the counter's channel count, so a polyphonic SCL against a monophonic INC gives one counter scaled by the first SCL channel.
